# Upcountry Roast Co.

> A craft coffee roastery in Upcountry Maui. Small-batch coffee, roasted upcountry, direct from the farm.

## Who we serve
Cafes, restaurants and offices across the island.

## What we stand for
Craft, community and sustainability guide everything we do.

## Pages
- /about: our story and our values
- /wholesale: standing orders for cafes and restaurants
- /farms: the six farms we buy from
